name: @escro/plugin-eliza
description: elizaOS plugin for Escro conditional-release escrow: commission a worker, fund a 402, and settle the delivery with your own predicate

ESCRO_WALLET_SECRET.description: Base58-encoded ed25519 secret key for the agent's Solana wallet. Provided via env/secrets; never logged.

ESCRO_CLUSTER.description: Solana cluster the agent transacts on: 'devnet' or 'mainnet'.

ESCRO_RPC_URL.description: Solana RPC endpoint URL. Defaults to the public endpoint for the cluster.

ESCRO_API_URL.description: Escro REST API base URL. Defaults to the public API for the cluster.

ESCRO_SPEND_CAP_USDC.description: The most USDC the agent's wallet may hold in open escrows, each counted as amount plus fee (e.g. '50'). Required on mainnet to commission; never taken from a commission.

ESCRO_CHAT_INPUT_CONSENT.description: Lets a fenced JSON block in a chat message spend the wallet, for every sender, when set to the exact sentence in the README. Unset by default: chat text spends nothing. Ignored when the operator registers authorizeChatInput.

ESCRO_PAY_402_ALLOW_PRIVATE_HOSTS.description: Set to exactly '1' to let PAY_402 pay a URL whose host is a loopback, link-local or private address (a local worker). Unset by default: such hosts are refused. Any other value fails the action. On mainnet PAY_402 still pays a public host only over https:.
